posts.title: The Pythia – Priestess of Ancient Delphi
posts.description: Dating back at least 2700 years, the ancient temple complex of Delphi was known throughout ancient Greece as the home of the Oracle of Apollo, the Greek god of prophecy, music, healing, and light. One controversial aspect of the ancient Oracle is the trance state attained by the sanctuary’s priestess (or Pythia). Read more >> The post The Pythia – Priestess of Ancient Delphi appeared first on Bria
